author: blu
body: Anonymous product types. `(a, b)` is sugar for `Tup2 a b`, `(a, b, c)` for `Tup3 a b c`, and so on up to five. Build one with the tuple expression `(x, y)`; take it apart with a tuple pattern in `when`: `is (x, y) -> ...`. Each `TupN` is a single-constructor variant, so a tuple pattern is always exhaustive.
